pipelines.title: Bench: staging handoff
pipelines.description: Two stages and one sequence edge. The first stage stages a draft; the second receives it and stages the result. Nothing routes, nothing loops: this is the plain handoff the other three are built on.

stages.title: Draft
stages.prompt: Write the draft the next stage will receive. Put it at bench/draft.md and say what it decided.

stages.title: Stage
stages.prompt: Read bench/draft.md and stage it as the handoff's artifact. Write bench/staged.md with the draft's decision and nothing new.

handoffs.note: The draft is the stager's only input.

pipelines.title: Bench: a gate that routes accept and reject
pipelines.description: Three stages and one routed gate. A review that accepts goes straight to publish; a review that rejects goes back to draft, which is the bounce. The gate's record is the only thing that crosses it.

stages.title: Draft
stages.prompt: Write the draft under review at bench/draft.md.

stages.title: Review
stages.prompt: Read bench/draft.md and write the review at bench/review.md. Do not decide the gate: the decider writes bench/verdict-<round>.json after you settle.

stages.title: Publish
stages.prompt: Read the accepted review and publish it at bench/published.md.

handoffs.note: The draft is what the reviewer decides on.
An acceptance hands the review on to the publisher.
A rejection returns the work to the drafter with the review.

gates.name: Accept or reject
gates.refuses_when: A rejection carries no review, or an acceptance leaves a note open.

pipelines.title: Bench: a row that waits behind a live row
pipelines.description: Two stages and one sequence edge, filed behind a row that is already running. The queue starts only its front row, so this pipeline must wait, name the row it waits behind, and start when that row settles.

stages.title: First
stages.prompt: Write bench/a.md with the first half of the work.

stages.title: Second
stages.prompt: Read bench/a.md and write bench/b.md with the second half.

handoffs.note: The first half is the second half's input.

pipelines.title: Bench: a two-way ping-pong that must stop
pipelines.description: Two stages whose only way out is a capped loop in each direction. The row must go back and forth until one cap is spent, then park for a decision: a walk that keeps starting stages past the bound is the loop this document exists to catch.

stages.title: Ping
stages.prompt: Write bench/ping.md, then hand it to pong. Do not invent an exit: the document's cap is what stops the round.

stages.title: Pong
stages.prompt: Read bench/ping.md, answer it at bench/pong.md, and hand it back to ping.

handoffs.note: Ping hands to pong; the cap counts the crossings of this edge.
Pong hands back to ping, under its own cap.
